svg.title: High-resolution to low-resolution commutator guidance diagram
svg.desc: Inventory: a four-panel figure. Top-left orange slanted high-resolution/low-resolution space diagram with axes, down arrow, trajectories, dots, labels and legend. Bottom-left blue prompt/results strip with prompt text, three generated-image blocks and check/cross badges. Right-top green rounded frame shows downsample matrix selection with colored tensors, thin tensors, ellipses and objective formula. Right-bottom pink rounded frame shows commutator-zero guidance with dashed/vector arrows and update equation. SAM mappings used after native construction: Original full-resolution image - draft-p003 - asset_sam_region_000061; naive image - draft-p005 - asset_sam_region_000063; ours image - draft-p004 - asset_sam_region_000062; red cross badge - draft-p002 - asset_sam_region_000060; green check badge - draft-p001 - asset_sam_region_000059. Equipartition basis: left side panels share vertical alignment, right side panels are stacked with equal width; bottom image triptych is horizontally partitioned; right tensor rows use regular spacing symmetry.

g.desc: Top-left origin is the lower-left slanted corner of the orange plane. Brown axes extend upward, rightward, and diagonally. A green vertical down arrow maps x_tD to D*x_tD. Black and purple trajectories move through blue/green/white samples toward target space; red dashed commutator guidance appears in the legend and along m-iteration loop.

Bottom-left origin is the left prompt paragraph; to the right are three equal image blocks with captions above and resolutions below. The center and right blocks carry overlaid red cross and green check icons, respectively. SAM images replace the three constructed image thumbnails and two badges.

Right-top origin is title. Downward/rightward conduction draws one large colored tensor for x_t^(i,j), several blue candidate matrices on the top row, their paired thin downsampled products on the lower row, ellipses, dimension arrows d and s, and a centered argmin formula box.

Right-bottom origin is the title, then arrows and blue points form two trajectories. A red commutator guidance vector connects the current point to the corrected direction; a formula strip spans the bottom. Symmetry basis: two nearly parallel dashed black trajectories with red/purple guidance arrows above and below.
